ability.name: Dokk Juice
ability.effect: If this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (1)** this unit. This unit cannot use this ability again for the rest of the battle.

ability.name: Monsta-killa Chompa
ability.effect: This unit has **^^Strike-first^^** while it is in combat with an enemy **^^Beast^^** or **^^Monster^^**.
